# External Datasets (consolidated 2026-09-26)

All external speech datasets for the AI-222/AI-231 voice projects now live in
**one place**: this directory, inside `Voice-Recognition-Mark-Dataset`.
Audio is **never committed to git** (see `.gitignore`) — it stays on shared
storage. Metadata, manifests, and download scripts are tracked.

## Layout

```
data/external/
├── DATASETS.md                  # this file
├── slurp/                       # SLURP (Spoken Language Understanding Resource Package)
│   ├── curated/                 #   900 FLAC: in-domain subset mapped to the 32-class ontology
│   │                            #   (referenced by manifest.csv rows with source=slurp)
│   ├── real/                    #   72,395 FLAC: full SLURP real audio (16 kHz)
│   ├── synth/                   #   10,272 FLAC: SLURP synthetic audio
│   ├── parquet/                 #   9 parquet shards, 3.7 GB: SLURP as distributed on HF
│   │                            #   (audio inline in parquet; used by Voice-Controlled-Smart-Device,
│   │                            #   which symlinks data/external/slurp/raw -> here)
│   ├── metadata/                #   train/devel/test/train_synthetic.jsonl, metadata.json, lm.txt
│   └── LICENSE.txt              #   Apache-2.0
├── fluent_speech_commands/      # Fluent Speech Commands (FSC)
│   ├── curated/                 #   900 WAV: in-domain subset mapped to the 32-class ontology
│   │                            #   (referenced by manifest.csv rows with source=fsc)
│   └── dataset/                 #   full extracted release: wavs/ (30,043), data/ CSVs,
│                                #   readme.md, public license PDF
├── google_speech_commands_v2/   # Google Speech Commands v2
│   └── speech_commands_v0.02.tar.gz   # 2.3 GB, unextracted (100k wavs, 35 classes)
├── librispeech/                 # LibriSpeech test-clean, curated subset
│   └── ls_*.flac                #   1,500 FLAC (referenced by manifest.csv source=librispeech;
│                                #   used as UNKNOWN/OOD training rows)
└── librispeech_test_clean/      # LibriSpeech test-clean, full
    ├── test-clean.tar.gz        #   346 MB archive (gitignored)
    └── LibriSpeech/             #   extracted (gitignored)
```

## Sources, licenses, re-download

| Dataset | License | Original source | Size here |
|---|---|---|---|
| SLURP | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/pswietojanski/slurp · https://huggingface.co/datasets/marcel-gohsen/slurp | ~8.4 GB (real+synth+parquet) |
| Fluent Speech Commands | FSC Public License (in `fluent_speech_commands/dataset/`) | https://zenodo.org/records/11106540 | ~2.1 GB |
| Google Speech Commands v2 | Apache-2.0 | https://www.tensorflow.org/datasets/catalog/speech_commands | 2.3 GB (archive) |
| LibriSpeech (test-clean) | CC-BY 4.0 | https://www.openslr.org/12/ | ~885 MB |

Re-download scripts: `Standalone-Voice-Command-Recognition-Project/scripts/download_datasets.py`
and `Voice-Controlled-Smart-Device/data/external/download_slurp*.sh`.

## How the data is referenced

- **`manifest.csv`** (repo root, tracked) is the primary metadata for the
  32-class CRNN. Its 3,300 external rows point at
  `data/external/{slurp,fluent_speech_commands,librispeech}/curated/...`.
  Regenerated by `scripts/map_external_data.py`.
- **`data/metadata/standalone/`** — canonical 32-class mapping from the
  Standalone project: `processed_metadata.csv` (67,189 rows),
  `dataset_mapping.csv`, `dataset_inspection.*`, `mapping_rules.json`,
  `plan_stats.json`.
- **`data/metadata/moonshine/`** — Moonshine baseline utterance list
  (`utterances.csv`, `manifest.json`, `labels.example.csv`).
- **`Voice-Controlled-Smart-Device/data/manifests/slurp_*.jsonl`** — 309-row
  real-audio subset used by the tiny VCM (audio in that repo's `data/audio/slurp/`).

## Consolidation log (2026-09-26)

Moved from `Standalone-Voice-Command-Recognition-Project/data/raw/`:
SLURP extracted real+synth, SLURP metadata, FSC extracted dataset,
Google Speech Commands v2 archive.
Moved from `Voice-Controlled-Smart-Device/data/external/`: SLURP parquet
shards (symlinked back so that repo's code keeps working), `DATASETS.md`
(rewritten as this file).
Copied from `voice-recognition-moonshine/data/`: utterances.csv,
manifest.json, labels.example.csv.

**Duplicates deleted** (all re-downloadable or regenerable):
- `slurp_real.tar.gz` + `slurp_synth.tar.gz` (6.4 GB — extracted copies kept)
- `fluentai.zip` (1.5 GB — extracted copy kept)
- SLURP upstream repo clone (16 MB — re-clone from GitHub)
- `processed/audio/` (4.1 GB, 67k WAVs — derived from raw via
  `scripts/build_canonical_dataset.py`; its metadata.csv is kept)
- `interim/headers_*.jsonl` (regenerable header dumps)
- empty `musan/`, `rir/`, `speech_commands/`, `manifests/` placeholder dirs

## Considered but NOT pulled (would bloat the repo)

- **Mozilla Common Voice** — CC0 but multi-GB per language; pull on demand
  from https://commonvoice.mozilla.org/ (or Kaggle mirror).
- **Snips SLU** — https://huggingface.co/datasets/MWilinski/snips_slu_v1.0
- **Timers and Such** — https://zenodo.org/records/4623772 (excluded earlier
  by instruction; re-add if timer-slot coverage is needed)
- **eSpeak NG** — TTS engine, not a dataset; generate synthetic audio on demand
- **Chatterbox TTS** — TTS model; generate on demand
- **SynTTS synthetic commands** — https://github.com/lugan113/SynTTS-Commands-Official
  (generate on demand; the OptionB set in the repo root already covers this role)
